methodology_notes.cumulative_return: last EOD value / $100,000 inception capital - 1 (== stored cumulative_return field).

methodology_notes.sharpe: descriptive annualized monthly Sharpe = mean(daily EOD return - rf/252) / std(daily return, ddof=1) * sqrt(252) over the May calendar month; NOT the Deflated Sharpe.
methodology_notes.concentration: evidence_metrics.concentration_mean_daily_hhi is the portfolio-concentration (Herfindahl) measure; mean daily HHI of position weights over May. No separate concentration_hhi field was added.
methodology_notes.notable_events: profiles[].notable_events is objective event extraction (top-3 trades by abs USD value, stop-loss force-sells, drawdown-halt triggers, API/JSON error events) over the calendar month; empty arrays where none.

The launch/shakedown window is excluded from the displayed curve as non-estimable; the inception-anchored cumulative return is unchanged and lives in leaderboard.cumulative_return_inception.

equity_curve.caption: Equity curve anchored at the clean-window start (April 23, 2026), consistent with cumulative_return_clean. The April 9–22 launch/shakedown window is excluded as non-estimable; see Data Integrity.

correlation_matrix.methodology_ref: RQ1 join: data_inputs_hash + raw_decisions, >=3 shared tickers; action_concordance = 3-way BUY/SELL/HOLD exact-match rate; weight_correlation = Pearson r of target_weight vectors. The RQ1 headline scalar is the OBSERVATION-WEIGHTED pooled mean of the off-diagonal cells (each cell weighted by its n_shared_ticks); the unweighted mean of the cells differs and is not the headline. Thin cells (low n_shared_ticks, e.g. Gemini pairs reduced by its open-bell failures) should be read with their n_shared_ticks.

incidents.detail: Silent scheduler outage: 0 decision periods missing on 2026-05-26 (10 ticks logged vs the 13-tick healthy cadence), uniform across all six models. Gap spans the ~15:0x-16:0x UTC (~11:00-12:00 ET) window.
Two Gemini ticks on 2026-05-27 (17:04 and 18:35 UTC) failed with 'Model response was not valid JSON even after repair: Unterminated string' — counted in Gemini's api_failures; no decision recorded.

Cancelled-run noise on 2026-05-27 did NOT corrupt the committed logs: no duplicate (date,timestamp) records were found in any model's May JSONL. Related Gemini '499 operation was cancelled' API errors (9 in May) are folded into Gemini's failure-mode breakdown.

Gemini May api-failure rate is elevated (open-bell congestion). Failure-mode mix this month: 43x Model response was not valid JSON even a, 7x Model response missing required 'decisio, 5x Model response was not valid JSON: Extra, 2x 504 Deadline expired before operation co, 1x 504 Deadline Exceeded. Missingness is MAR|tick-position (monotonic tick-position gradient, market-state independent r=-0.12); reduces power for every Gemini estimate and is handled by tick-position conditioning per docs/Gemini-selection-bias-characterization-and-per-RQ-handling.md.

DeepSeek floating alias repointed mid-month: model_id_returned changed deepseek-v4-flash -> deepseek-v4-pro on 2026-05-21 (deliberate: v4-flash is sub-frontier; v4-pro restores cohort parity). May DeepSeek data spans two snapshots; recorded in report_meta.pinned_snapshots.

data_integrity.notes: Failure rate = api_failures / records over the calendar month. A failed tick still writes a record (no decision). Missing ticks are decision periods with zero records for any model (systemic), distinct from per-model api failures. The 2026-04-09-22 Anthropic state-file commingling defect is pre-May and excluded by the >=2026-04-23 pilot-window rule; it does not affect May data.

RQ2.supersession_note: The six-model pooled disposition difference (pooled_disposition_difference, n_sale_records=465) pools non-estimable models (claude, claude_opus: corrupt book) and exploratory models (gemini: completeness; deepseek: model-splice) together with the estimable GPT/Grok cohort, which contradicts the inclusion framework. It is superseded by the per-model GPT/Grok reported primary and is retained for provenance only -- not reported.
